gloss: year after year; with each passing year

definitions.gloss: year after year; with each passing year
definitions.explanation: A literary or emphatic expression meaning every single year, emphasizing the repetitive nature of change over time. More formal and literary than {年々|ねんねん}.

examples.japanese: {年々歳々|ねんねんさいさい}⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: Year after year the flowers are the same, but people change.
examples.notes: From a famous Chinese poem by Liu Xiyi.

examples.japanese: {年々歳々|ねんねんさいさい}、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{風景|ふうけい}→風景：03591_fuukei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{変|か}わって→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧いく。
examples.english: Year after year, the scenery of this town keeps changing.

examples.japanese: {年々歳々|ねんねんさいさい}⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進歩|しんぽ}→進歩：03265_shinpo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧になっている。
examples.english: With each passing year, technology advances and life becomes more convenient.

notes:
USAGE:
A literary four-character expression (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧) originating from a Tang Dynasty Chinese poem. More emphatic and literary than the simpler ⟦{年々|ねんねん}→年々：10417_nennen⟧. Often used in reflective or philosophical contexts about the passage of time.

ETYMOLOGY:
From a poem by Liu Xiyi ({劉希夷|りゅうきい}): 「{年年歳歳|ねんねんさいさい}⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧{相似|あいにたり}、{歳歳年年|さいさいねんねん}⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧{不同|おなじからず}」— "Year after year the flowers are alike; year after year the people are different."

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{年々|ねんねん}→年々：10417_nennen⟧: year by year — the simpler, more common form
- ⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧: every year — a neutral, everyday expression
